title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis in Jacobian-Space: Language and Vision Models Agree Approximately Up to a Rotation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33304v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) posits that AI models converge toward a shared representation of the world, even when trained on different data modalities. Previous work has found evidence for the PRH in the activations of vision and language models. In this work, we ask whether vision and language models also converge in how they act on these representations: precisely, in how these internal representations affect the models' output. At a chosen layer of a transformer, the Jacobian lens gives every word in the vocabulary (or class in an image classifier) a vector in the hidden state: the vector that most increases the model's tendency to generate that word, at that position or later, or to predict that class. Collectively, these vectors make up what is referred to as the model's J-space. We find evidence of the PRH in J-space across vision and language models, and furthermore, we find that J-spaces mostly converge up to a r

translated_title: 雅可比空间中的柏拉图表示假说：语言模型与视觉模型在近似相差一个旋转的意义上达成一致
translated_abstract: 柏拉图表示假说（PRH）认为，即使在不同数据模态上训练，AI模型也会收敛到对世界的一种共享表示。先前的工作已经在视觉模型和语言模型的激活中找到了支持该假说的证据。在这项工作中，我们探讨视觉模型和语言模型是否也在它们作用于这些表示的方式上收敛：具体而言，即这些内部表示如何影响模型的输出。在Transformer的选定层上，雅可比透镜为词表中的每个词（或图像分类器中的每个类别）在隐藏状态中对应一个向量：该向量最能提升模型在该位置或后续位置生成该词的倾向，或预测该类别的倾向。这些向量共同构成了所谓的模型J空间（雅可比空间）。我们发现在视觉模型和语言模型的J空间中也存在支持柏拉图表示假说的证据，并且进一步发现，各模型的J空间在近似相差一个旋转的意义上大体收敛。
tldr: 该研究将柏拉图表示假说从模型激活扩展到雅可比空间，发现语言模型与视觉模型不仅在内部表示上、而且在表示影响模型输出的方式（J空间）上也收敛，且这种一致性在近似相差一个旋转的意义上成立。
en_tdlr: This work extends the Platonic Representation Hypothesis to Jacobian-space, showing that language and vision models converge not only in internal activations but also in how their representations affect outputs, agreeing approximately up to a rotation.
